name: TC-SUPPORT-E2E: Complete Support Module Navigation, Date Filter, Ticket Creation & Dashboard Flow
description:
Single-session verification of the complete Support Ticket workflow:
1. Authenticate and navigate to Support module
2. Apply 'Last Month Onwards' date filter
3. Open Add Support modal and fill ticket details (Problem, Solution, Customer details)
4. Select Disposition, Sub Disposition, and Status
5. Submit ticket and verify success toast notification
6. Verify record in Support History Grid and navigate to Support Dashboard
